Historia Inquisitionis (Latin) (Philipp van Limborch, 1692)
======================================================================
Limborch's Historia Inquisitionis (Amsterdam, 1692) in the original Latin — the classic Protestant history of the Inquisition and the edition Chandler translated in 1731. Staged alongside the English as the documentary original. Public domain. Sourced from Internet Archive: scan of the 1692 edition (https://archive.org/details/per_witchcraft-in-europe-and-america_historia-inquisitionis_limborch-philippus_1692_1_578).
